_comment: Official news feeds per game, keyed by the game's role name in server/layout.py GAMES. Each value is {"steam_appid": N} (public Steam news API, official announcements only) or {"rss": "https://..."} (an official RSS/Atom feed; links must stay on that feed's host). A game left out gets no news. Checked with curl on 2026-10-08; 'comment' says how.

Wardogs.comment: Steam store search 'wardogs' -> 1867240 WARDOGS; GetNewsForApp returns its steam_community_announcements patch notes.

Call of Duty.comment: Steam store search -> 1938090 'Call of Duty' (the HQ app); GetNewsForApp returns official Black Ops/Warzone announcements.

Counter-Strike 2.comment: Steam app 730 is Counter-Strike 2; GetNewsForApp returns the official 'Counter-Strike 2 Update' announcements.

Apex Legends.comment: Steam store search -> 1172470 Apex Legends; GetNewsForApp returns official 'Latest Update' announcements.

GTA Online.comment: Steam app 271590 is Grand Theft Auto V; Rockstar posts GTA Online event announcements there (also on 3240220, GTA V Enhanced).

Minecraft.comment: Mojang's own feed on minecraft.net: RSS 2.0 in UTF-16, article links on www.minecraft.net. The site stalls on User-Agents containing 'bot', so the fetcher sends 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; FrontDesk/1.0)'.
